CJP launches 'Cockroach Club' for youth engagement

The Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP) has launched a new initiative called 'Cockroach Club' aimed at engaging young people. The club is intended to foster political and cultural discussions among the youth, particularly in a context where protest momentum may be fading.
